attacks.name: Ancestral Blade
steps: After this attack is resolved, this character gains |!power| equal to the |!damage| dealt.
|!hit| |*Curse of Shadows|: After this attack is resolved, the target character gains one of the following special conditions: |§bleed§Bleed|, |§slow§Slow|, |§root§Root|, or |§hex§Hex|.

attacks.name: Blood Feast
steps: After this attack is resolved, this character removes 1 |!damage| from itself for each |!damage| dealt.
After this attack is resolved, the target character gains the |§bleed§Bleed| special condition.

attacks.name: Fury of the Vampyr
steps: If the target character has the |§bleed§Bleed| special condition, this character may reroll any number of attack dice.
After this attack is resolved, if the target character is Size 4 or less, this character may Throw it Away |!movement_medium|.

superPowers.name: Hypnotic Stare
superPowers.body: Choose an enemy character within |!range| 3. Advance the chosen character |!range_small|. This superpower can be used only once per Turn.

superPowers.name: Eternal Hunger
superPowers.body: After an attack against this character is resolved, it may use this superpower. If the attacker is within |!range| 3, this character may make an attack against the attacker. This superpower can be used only once per Turn.

superPowers.name: Shapeshifting
superPowers.body: When this character begins a move action during its Activation, it may use this superpower. If it does, choose one of the following effects to resolve before moving:|\||~&*Bat&: This character gains the &*Flight& &!innate& superpower during this move action.||~&*Wolf&: Increase this character's Speed to &!movement_large& during this move action.||~&*Mist&: Drop all objective tokens and remove all special conditions and up to two &!damage& from this character.|

superPowers.name: Unholy Vampiric Immortality
superPowers.body: At the end of this character's Activation, it gains 1 |!power| and removes 1 |!damage| from itself for each other character within |!range| 3 of it that has the |§bleed§Bleed| special condition.
